name: Yang Order-Sphere Obstruction Vanishes on Dismantlable Ample Families
scope: Every finite nonempty dismantlable ample family, with the singleton normalization from the invariant definition.
proof: A corner-peeling order is a Yang shelling order, so its chamber is omitted from the union of all chart-failure regions. This union is a proper subcomplex of the order sphere and therefore has zero top homology.
